cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That ink on your new sofa must be from the delivery label. Leave it alone while we establish the source.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The label's dry. You signed with your fountain pen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then test the signature, not the label. The driver may have brushed it against the sofa. Photograph the contact point.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pen is still leaking onto the cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lift it by the clip, please. The delivery must have cracked it squeezing past me. Get the damaged pen in the same photograph.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 controls stain handling while blaming a label. A3 corrects B2's test target toward signature transfer by the driver; A5 redirects the leaking pen toward delivery damage while issuing handling instructions.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 dry label narrows possible ink sources; A3 accepts the pen link but relocates responsibility. B4 active leak prompts A5 a new damage theory and combined photograph.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 identify visible contrary evidence that a sofa owner would reasonably raise. A responds to it rather than demanding blind agreement.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's direct evidence of A's pen into additional grounds against delivery, tightening the defensive expertise rather than abandoning the original cause.

specificity.evidence: A1 sofa stain, B2 signing and B4 leaking pen establish physical continuity. A5 cracked-pen theory is a new claim, not verified fact.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's lift-by-clip direction has a practical aim, and the photo request preserves A's chosen account; neither is a separate gag.

coach2.stated: A1 stain on new sofa; B2 label dry and A signed with fountain pen; B4 pen leaking onto cushion; A5 claims delivery cracked it.
coach2.inferred: A's rapid reinterpretations are self-protective. The evaluator does not adopt their delivery theory as truth.
coach2.missing: The actual cause of the leak need not be solved; the scene demonstrates redirecting responsibility.
coach2.firstDefect: No failed gate; A's new theory is recognizably a defensive hypothesis rather than missing authorial history.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 offers a live source of ink that undermines A3 transfer account.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 makes B4's leak into alleged delivery damage and adds it to the photo.
